body:
LEAD ACCEPT — D2 V7 must be recut before landing.

I verified both findings against the official FFmpeg contracts and inspected the current V7 text. V7 distinguishes missing timestamps, unknown duration, and arithmetic/quantization refusal in general, but it does not yet state the two decisive source-boundary courts:

1. Provenance-sensitive INT64_MIN: AV_NOPTS_VALUE in a packet field is MissingTimestamp; INT64_MIN returned by av_rescale_rnd for an unrepresentable result is ArithmeticRefusal. AV_ROUND_PASS_MINMAX passthrough must not turn missingness into a coordinate. Raw-value-only classification must fail.
2. Cross-field packet law: once an actual demuxed/converted packet exposes both fields, pts < dts is a typed SourceContractViolation/refusal with original fields retained. No swapping, clamping, relabelling, or reordering is admissible.

These belong at the source-ingest/C1 boundary, expressed in D2 as normative requirements and mutation courts; they are not generic semantic-mapping rules and D2 will not implement FFmpeg code. I am superseding V7 with a narrow V8 documentation amendment, then will request fresh component and scout review. V7 is not to be landed.
